purpose: Preregistered runtime admission (not capability qualification) for model candidates. Functional weaknesses discovered here are research outcomes, not grounds to exclude a mandatory model (S1/S2). The competitive candidate S3 is selected by this development protocol only; holdout performance never informs selection.

subjects.S2: LFM3-1.7B or the verified current Liquid AI small instruct model (mandatory)
subjects.S3: Best qualified contemporary 1-3B instruct model; selected by this protocol from >=3 verified ModelScope candidates
subjects.R1: Reference ~7-8B instruct (prefer Qwen3-8B, already represented in project evidence)
subjects.R2: Reference ~12-14B instruct (prefer Qwen3-14B, already represented in project evidence)

quantization_policy.admission_runs: Q8_0 for admission smoke (comparable across architectures); Q4_K_M repeated on finalists
quantization_policy.rule: Nominally identical quantization types are not assumed equivalent across architectures; quantization experiments are separated from SDK comparisons (A10).

smoke_suite.runtime: llama.cpp b12359 llama-server, loopback, managed start with D-010 GPU proof; Q8_0; context 8192; greedy decoding (temperature 0, seed 47)

cases.description: Follow a simple two-constraint instruction in English and in Chinese
Emit a valid JSON object matching a given flat schema, 30 dev cases, threshold >= 90% valid JSON
With tools present, answer directly when no tool applies; no invented call
Select the correct tool of 4 and emit well-formed arguments; threshold >= 80% over 30 dev cases
Use a tool result as the argument of a second call and state the final fact; threshold >= 70%
Two to three dependent calls in order; threshold >= 50%
Recover after one deliberately rejected call (bad argument) without repeating it verbatim
Answer a question whose evidence sits > 3000 tokens back in the prompt
Terminate within the token budget; no runaway loop; EOS honored

selection_rule_for_S3: Rank verified candidates by a fixed development score: sum of the ten smoke-case pass rates (each equally weighted, 30 dev cases each, one frozen dev set per case family generated before any candidate runs). Highest total wins; ties broken by lower token cost per correct case; remaining ties by smaller parameter count. No holdout data is consulted.

reference_models.role: capability comparison anchors only; excluded from the 2B-class product ranking
reference_models.data_policy: R1/R2 results are reported separately and never mixed into small-model rankings.

passports: Every admitted model receives a full passport (weights source/revision/SHA256, tokenizer, chat template SHA256, native tool-calling spec, context, license and commercial terms, known limitations) in evidence/IJSDK/P2/model_passports/.
